# FQHEDiskDensityMC

Module: **FQHE** · directory: `FQHE/src/FQHEOnDisk` · binary: `FQHE/src/Programs/FQHEOnDisk/FQHEDiskDensityMC`

```text
FQHEDiskDensityMC, version 0.01

Usage: FQHEDiskDensityMC [options] 

Options:

system options:
    -p, --nbr-particles : number of particles (default value = 10)
    --list-wavefunctions : list all available test wave fuctions
    --laughlin : do the calculation for the Laughlin state instead of the Moore-Read state
    --test-symmetry : check the test wave function is symmetric/antisymmetric
    --load-permutations : read all the permutations needed to compute the reference wave function from a file
    --save-permutations : file name where all the permutations needed to compute the reference wave function have to be stored
    --boson : use bosonic statistics instead of fermionic statistic
    --quasielectron : plot quasiparticles instead of the ground state
    --quasihole : plot quasiholes instead of the ground state
    --excitation-position : position of the excitation from the center (in grid length unit) (default value = 0.14999999999999999)
    --force-xsymmetry : assume the wave function is invariant under the x <->-x symmetry
    --force-ysymmetry : assume the wave function is invariant under the y <->-y symmetry
    --force-rsymmetry : assume the wave function is invariant under rotation
    -o, --output : output file name

Monte Carlo options:
    -s, --nbr-step : number of steps for the density profil in each direction (default value = 20)
    --grid-length : size of the sampling grid (in unit of the magnetic length (default value = 20)
    --jump : length of the jump used for the metropolis algorithm (default value = 0.29999999999999999)
    -i, --nbr-iter : number of Monte Carlo iterations (default value = 10000)
    --nbr-warmup : number of Monte Carlo iterations that have to be done before evaluating the energy (i.e. warm up sequence) (default value = 10000)
    -r, --resume : resume from a previous run
    --display-step : number of iteration between two consecutive result displays (default value = 1000)
    --record-step : number of iteration between two consecutive result recording of energy value (0 if no on-disk recording is needed) (default value = 0)
    --record-file : name of the file where energy recording has to be done
    --with-timecoherence : use time coherence between two successive evaluation of the wave function
    --show-details : show intermediate values used for overlap calculation
    --random-file : name of the file where random number to use are stored (use internal random generator if no file name is provided)
    --random-seek : if usage of a random number file is activiated, jump the first random numbers up to the seek position (default value = 0)
    --record-wavefunctions : optional file where each wavefunctions will be tabulated and recorded

parallelization options:
    -S, --SMP : enable SMP mode
    --processors : number of processors to use in SMP mode (default value = 2)
    --smp-profil : enable SMP profiling, the name of the log file  has to be passed as argument

misc options:
    -h, --help : display this help

global options:
    --append-cmdline : append command line to file
```
